messages:
incident-bot: PAGING — INCIDENT 1834567890: SLO breach detected for customer 'Atlas' (enterprise, eu-west-1) on dedicated-pool-42. Error rate >5% for 3m. Pager: oncall-prim
oncall-prim: ack — I'm on it, looking at grafana + traces
eng-runtime-li: seeing elevated tail latency and a spike in KV cache misses for pool-42. Timeline shows a model variant change around 09:12 UTC, then errors started climbing
infra-sam: i didn't see a full deploy in k8s but the autoscaler did a scale-down at 09:09 and then a scale-up at 09:14. sounds like thrash combined with heavier model compute
oncall-prim: can we isolate Atlas requests to a warm fallback variant? Atlas is enterprise — we should avoid cross-tenant bleed
eng-runtime-li: Atlas is in dedicated-pool-42 (tenant-isolated), but the routing config bumped them to v2-quant earlier. v2-quant has higher per-token latency. fallback to v1-quant should be compatible. I'll push a routing override now
eng-runtime-li: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routing/override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"pool":"pool-42","route":"v1-quant","duration":"30m"}'
```
infra-sam: applied routing override, /routing/config returns 200 and shows override active for pool-42
oncall-prim: metrics updating — errors coming down, p95 latency trending down as well. holding watch
sre-jen: customer impact note: Atlas reported ~220 timeouts across /chat-stream during the 8m window. flagging acct-ops-matt to start comms
acct-ops-matt: thanks. I'll draft a customer note and an exec summary. any quick root-cause guess so i can include in the first touch?
eng-runtime-li: preliminary root cause: variant rollout -> heavier compute on quant path + cache cold starts because autoscaler scaled too low -> increased KV miss penalty. combined produced SLO breaches. needs follow-up RCA
oncall-prim: next ops steps: keep routing override for 1h, set pool min-replicas=4 to avoid immediate thrash, and enable KV prefetch for Atlas prefix for 30m. infra, can you patch minReplicas?
infra-sam: setting minReplicas=4 on pool-42 now. kubectl patch output snippet: ```deployment.apps/pool-42 patched (currentReplicas: 2 -> 4)```
eng-platform-ali: enabling KV prefetch for atlas/* prefix for 30m from the control-plane side
oncall-prim: good. once latencies are stable we'll transition to post-incident mode. acct-ops-matt you own the customer comms and the exec note. i'll own the RCA timeline + mitigation tasks
acct-ops-matt: will send a draft to the Atlas contacts by EOD. proposing a goodwill offer: 5% monthly credit + some reserved dedicated hours for next month; will align with legal after initial reachout
eng-runtime-li: i'll run token-level failure queries to precisely quantify failures and the exact affected time window. i'll drop the query results into the RCA doc: https://rco.internal/1834567890/rca-draft
sre-jen: RCA draft is live (short summary, timeline, root cause, mitigations, action items). ping me if you want to iterate. major action items: stricter minReplica defaults for dedicated pools, autoscaler hysteresis tweak, route-override playbook
acct-ops-matt: scheduling a 1:1 with Atlas PM + infra lead for tomorrow 10:00 UTC to walk through mitigation and proposed credits
oncall-prim: handing follow-up to infra + platform for longer-term fixes. marking incident as mitigated. incident-bot, please close the active page and create a postmortem stub if not present
incident-bot: INCIDENT 1834567890 — STATUS: mitigated -> resolved. Severity P1 -> P2. Postmortem created: https://rco.internal/postmortems/1834567890. Reminder: RCA + exec note due 24h, customer comms draft due EOD.
